svg.metadata:
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block title "Rainbow rings — line order is the layer"
# Seven concentric ellipses. Earlier lines paint first (bottom), later lines # paint on top: DOCUMENT ORDER IS PAINT ORDER, and (`PAINT-ORDER-CONSTRUCT`) it # is the only paint order the language has — the ring effect is the whole # demonstration that no directive was needed to get one.
# decorative # A rendering demo: the concentric geometry IS the subject (paint order), # not knowledge about relationships. Nothing here must survive the strip test.
node red " " shape=ellipse fill=#ef4444 stroke=#ef4444 pin red at=(20,20) width=560 height=560 node orange " " shape=ellipse fill=#f97316 stroke=#f97316 pin orange at=(60,60) width=480 height=480 node yellow " " shape=ellipse fill=#facc15 stroke=#facc15 pin yellow at=(100,100) width=400 height=400 node green " " shape=ellipse fill=#22c55e stroke=#22c55e pin green at=(140,140) width=320 height=320 node blue " " shape=ellipse fill=#3b82f6 stroke=#3b82f6 pin blue at=(180,180) width=240 height=240 node indigo " " shape=ellipse fill=#6366f1 stroke=#6366f1 pin indigo at=(220,220) width=160 height=160 node violet " " shape=ellipse fill=#a855f7 stroke=#a855f7 pin violet at=(260,260) width=80 height=80 # The white core carries the wordmark, so its box must be the size the text # needs: 40x36 centred on (300,300), which is the outline the retired # `shape=cloud` used to draw for a 20x20 box (rx=w/2+10, ry=h/2+8). node core "FigDown" shape=ellipse fill=#ffffff stroke=#ffffff pin core at=(280,282) width=40 height=36
